name: Thaumaturgy (Soul of the Serpent) — 2 Intermediate — Venom Curse

system.description:
The Thaumaturge transforms a mouthful of her own vitae into a deadly venom, akin to that of a spitting cobra, which she spits at the eyes of a nearby opponent to blind them.

System: The Thaumaturge spends one blood point and wins a Physical Challenge against the target to strike his eyes; a struck mortal is blinded for a lengthy duration (Storyteller's discretion, typically until healed or magically cured) and permanently unless treated within the hour, while supernatural creatures recover more quickly. The venom is only potent while fresh from the Thaumaturge's body.
